_readme: Dedicated thumbnail images (team vote 2026-11-06). Flow, 16:9, ONE image at a time, reference character/leo_cap_sheet.png. Save as <vdir>/thumbnail_hero.png, then: python thumbnail.py <vdir> --hero <vdir>/thumbnail_hero.png --text "<variant>" --side <left|right>. Text is placed by thumbnail.py, never by AI. text_variants were drafted by the job (ChatGPT round still to do: the team picks one).
template: IMAGES ONLY, do NOT create any videos. Generate ONE 16:9 image. Leo must look exactly like the attached character sheet (stickman with a yellow backwards cap and brown hair tuft): a simple stickman with a big round white head, black outline, simple expressive eyes and mouth, a yellow baseball cap worn backwards with a small tuft of brown hair, thin black line body and limbs, round black hands and black oval feet. YouTube thumbnail composition: Leo's head and shoulders very large on the {side} third of the frame, close-up, {emotion}. Plain simple {background} background with soft light, high contrast, bold clean outlines. The other {empty_side} half of the frame is EMPTY plain background, no objects, left free for text. Exactly one Leo, two arms. No text, no letters, no logos, no glasses.

v45.emotion: wide-eyed shock, mouth open, eyebrows high, one hand over his mouth, as if he just blurted out a painfully honest truth

v47.emotion: nervous curious face, eyes sideways, small awkward smile, one hand half raised in a hesitant wave

v49.emotion: overjoyed disbelief, huge open-mouth smile, wide sparkling eyes, both hands on his cheeks

c2.emotion: blissful satisfied face, eyes closed, big smile, a hand on his full belly, cozy holiday mood

c3.emotion: stressed self-critical face, frowning, eyes squeezed, both hands pressed on his head
